flaps._comment: CJ4 operator guide documents VFE 15 degrees at 200 KIAS and 35 degrees at 160 KIAS.

grades._comment: Provisional light-jet landing bands pending CJ4-specific in-sim verification.

lvars._comment: This profile uses documented standard SimVars only; no Working Title-specific telemetry routes are enabled.

controls._comment: Only standard gear/flaps surface fallback is allowed. The CJ4 guide references binding AUTO THROTTLE TO GA for the TOGA button, but Flight Fabric does not expose a semantic TOGA control here, and FGP/autopilot writes remain unavailable without a documented and independently verified route.

meta.notes: Source-backed profile for the included Cessna Citation CJ4. The Working Title operator guide provides simulation-specific weight, flap, gear, and procedure context. Custom telemetry and controls remain inactive because the cited sources do not define a CJ4 external integration map.

sources.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 FAQ - aircraft matrix
sources.notes: Lists Cessna Citation CJ4 as included with Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Standard, Deluxe, Premium Deluxe, and Aviator editions.

sources.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator - Aircraft Manuals
sources.notes: Provides a Cessna Citation CJ4 Version 1 guide from Working Title. The page does not publish an external telemetry/control variable map.

sources.name: MSFS Cessna Citation CJ4 Model 525C Operator's Guide v1
sources.notes: Documents CJ4 weight limits, VFE 15 degrees at 200 KIAS and 35 degrees at 160 KIAS, VLE 200 KIAS, no autothrottle, FMS-generated V-speeds, and the AUTO THROTTLE TO GA workaround. No external LVAR/B-var/control variable list is provided.

sources.name: MSFS 2024 Avionics Framework - SimVars
sources.notes: Documents standard MSFS SimVars/A-vars as queryable simulator state. This profile intentionally activates no aircraft-specific L: or B: variables.

knownIssues: Exact MSFS 2024 CJ4 title strings remain unverified in-sim.
Flap detent labels and VFE are manual-backed, but their runtime handle-index order still needs in-sim verification.
The cited sources do not define a CJ4 external LVAR, B-var, or input-event map.
Autopilot/FGP and TOGA controls are intentionally not mapped until Flight Fabric has verified semantic writes for this aircraft.
